schema: CREATE TABLE resource_calls(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,kind TEXT NOT NULL,endpoint TEXT NOT NULL,model TEXT NOT NULL,last_seq INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE resource_chunks(call_id TEXT NOT NULL,seq INTEGER NOT NULL,chunk INTEGER NOT NULL,raw_start INTEGER NOT NULL,raw_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL,payload BLOB NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(call_id,seq,chunk))
CREATE TABLE resource_events(call_id TEXT NOT NULL,seq INTEGER NOT NULL,kind TEXT NOT NULL,raw_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(call_id,seq))
CREATE TABLE resource_usage_actors(call_id TEXT NOT NULL,actor TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(call_id,actor))

CREATE TABLE resource_usage_calls(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,model TEXT NOT NULL,requests INTEGER NOT NULL,responses INTEGER NOT NULL,errors INTEGER NOT NULL,input_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL,output_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL,total_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL,input_reports INTEGER NOT NULL,output_reports INTEGER NOT NULL,total_reports INTEGER NOT NULL,cancelled INTEGER NOT NULL,decode_errors INTEGER NOT NULL,embedding_uses INTEGER NOT NULL,duration_s REAL NOT NULL,queue_s REAL NOT NULL,jitter_s REAL NOT NULL,provider_s REAL NOT NULL,duration_reports INTEGER NOT NULL,queue_reports INTEGER NOT NULL,jitter_reports INTEGER NOT NULL,provider_reports INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE resource_usage_totals(scope INTEGER NOT NULL,actor TEXT NOT NULL,model TEXT NOT NULL,requests INTEGER NOT NULL,responses INTEGER NOT NULL,errors INTEGER NOT NULL,input_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL,output_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL,total_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL,input_reports INTEGER NOT NULL,output_reports INTEGER NOT NULL,total_reports INTEGER NOT NULL,cancelled INTEGER NOT NULL,decode_errors INTEGER NOT NULL,embedding_uses INTEGER NOT NULL,duration_s REAL NOT NULL,queue_s REAL NOT NULL,jitter_s REAL NOT NULL,provider_s REAL NOT NULL,duration_reports INTEGER NOT NULL,queue_reports INTEGER NOT NULL,jitter_reports INTEGER NOT NULL,provider_reports INTEGER NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(scope,actor,model))
